notes: The supplied juncture and belongs to the finite verb it introduces under rules 88 and 29, not to the participle βλέποντες it follows.
ἑαυτῶν takes your own selves whole and heads on the -self word under rule 107; the ASV writes no separate word for a second pronoun token here.
ἐστίν is expressed, so no copula is supplied and rule 53 does not arise.
